cd /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation; cat > /tmp/dump68.py <<'EOF'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w68-20261012/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f4a2.json'))['payload']
dec=json.JSONDecoder()
def parse(s):
    if not isinstance(s,str): return [s]
    i=0;objs=[]
    while i<len(s):
        o,j=dec.raw_decode(s,i); objs.append(o); i=j
        while i<len(s) and s[i] in ' \n\t': i+=1
    return objs
ctx={b['revision_key']:parse(b['context']) for b in d['bounded_context']}
tr={t['revision_key']:t for t in d['translation_snapshot']}
out=[]
for n,k in enumerate(d['ordered_revision_keys']):
    t=tr[k]; cs=ctx[k]
    out.append(f"=== #{n} {k[:10]}")
    for c in cs:
        out.append(f"keys={list(c.keys())}")
        out.append(f"file={c.get('file')}:{c.get('line')} sec={c.get('section')} tag={c.get('source_tag')}")
        se=c.get('source_evidence') or {}
        out.append(f"comp={se.get('component')} path={se.get('public_source_path')} lines={se.get('matching_lines')}")
        for kk,v in c.items():
            if kk not in ('file','line','section','source_tag','source_evidence','adjacent_translations'):
                out.append(f"{kk}: {json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)[:1500]}")
        out.append("adj: "+json.dumps(c.get('adjacent_translations'),ensure_ascii=False)[:800])
    out.append("SRC: "+json.dumps(t['source'],ensure_ascii=False))
    out.append("TGT: "+json.dumps(t['target'],ensure_ascii=False))
open('/tmp/dump68.txt','w').write("\n".join(out))
EOF
